description: This file defines the IMembershipGossiper interface within the Orleans.Runtime.MembershipService namespace. It declares a method for gossiping membership information to remote silos.

classes.name: IMembershipGossiper
classes.description: An internal interface for gossiping membership data between silos in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GossipToRemoteSilos
methods.description: Initiates gossiping membership information to a list of remote silo addresses with the given snapshot and updated status.
